no one allow us to move an inch without their permission and we are under their watchful eyes every single time. We cannot decide on our own as long as we are living with them.

Going to school is very important for our life. As girls that is the only place where we are allowed to play and learn something that makes a difference in our life. Otherwise, when I get back home, I have plenty of things to do to support my mother and I have no place to play or study.

School is very crucial for the life of especially girls. If a girl is educated she can change the world. Girls are serous in our area about their education but no one gives them the attention. Our parents say “you will be someone else’s wife and never come back to me so why would I invest on you?” . Anyways, school makes you learn how to read a write and if you read you can learn lots of things.

school is important for us. It is where we learn how to be a proper person, it teaches us about science, how we get sick and how we prevent sickness, it teaches us math and understand how to calculate, it teaches us about our environment and everything. So it is important.

boys in this area are lazy. Families are eager to educate their boys but they are extremely useless. They prefer to go to XX town and engage in petty trading, they take fish from the XX lake and sale it in the village and when they get money they will start using khat or smoke etc.

Yes it is as she said, they usually drop out early. Girls tend to struggle as far as she can go it is only the family that may make stop her. Otherwise, many girls would like to finish their school. Both girls and boys y have to go as far as collage and university. They have to be able to finish their studies.
I do not if there is an end to education. They should at least be educated in the university.
for me if it is possible that would be great if they finish university. If not, they should at least reach 12th grade I feel that will help them become better farmers at least.
in my opinion, there is better understanding and commitment towards educating boys than girls.

one it is far from here. Transport is expensive, we need to use the motorcycles to go to town. We are also afraid we may get abducted. Or one of our brothers would arrange our abduction.

previously women were not engaged in agriculture. They stay home so all agricultural activities were performed by the men. we can do weeding, planting, applying fertilizers, harvesting storing.

• Families leave this please to go to their other land once they harvest their maize from here and stay there until around April.

• Getting married

• Lack of support from the family
• Getting married

Only chicken is introduced recently. Cow is important for women as they use the milk for their family and they also sale milk and butter. However, they cannot sale the cow, because it belongs to the man. A woman cannot sale livestock. This has never changed. [What about “Inset”?] Inset is also important then and now because she feed her family especially during food shortage time. It is not controlled by the man.
[they almost burst out and started discussing]

Now some men are controlling every single false banana tree and they know how much kilogram of “kocho” or” Bulla” [the different types of food that is extracted from false banana tree] can be processed and he will instruct her to take only small amount because if he sales it, it means a lot of money. So “inset” is has become important since it is also consumed by town dwellers. [will he sale inset products himself?] He would not he will send her to sale.

haricot beans used to be grown for household consumption by mothers only. The women usually grows it and use it in the house and sale some when they need money. However, these days it has become expensive so the men have taken over and also is being produced in larger quantities than before. There are even some men who have stopped growing maize because it is not as profitable as the beans.

No these time everybody works together. Actually in my opinion, I do not know if my friends will agree with me but women are taking most of the agricultural activities. Men are more or less doing other things mainly serving in the church or are traveling for some reason.
